reuse.why: Puts the rule in the existing getScheduledAmount, uses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance, and routes the API field and every inline midpoint copy through the helper.

duplication.why: Removes the five inline missing/number/midpoint copies (schedules/app.ts x2, forecast, schedule-template, preview); nothing new is duplicated.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts; server, API and UI callers only pass their amount and operator.

scope.why: Changes are the helper, its callers, the API type and field, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: One function with an explicit operator decides the expected amount for every consumer; the parameter reorder is safe since no caller passed inverse.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server paths, the API model and the desktop-client list/balance views call getScheduledAmount with the operator; only the schedule editor's default (useScheduleEdit) still passes no operator.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline copies are removed, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained the op parameter and an isapprox branch that reuses getApproxNumberThreshold; every planning call site uses it and none re-implements it.
